item.title: [Asian Mirror - Business] Wimal Weerawansa at Court of Appeal over contempt complaint
item.description: Former Minister Wimal Weerawansa arrived at the Court of Appeal today (12) in connection with a contempt of court complaint filed by the Colombo Fort Magistrate. The court was due to reconsider the complaint today. Weerawansa was named as a respondent, and his lawyers were expected to make submissions on his behalf.
